summary: The game features a polished HUD, start screen, and sloped streets, but fails on core visual and gameplay goals. The city consists of generic colored boxes in pitch darkness rather than realistic San Francisco architecture, the car model is an overly simplistic two-box shape that gets completely stuck against a building gap during basic turning, no opponent Waymos are visible in the scene, and firing the laser produces no visible beam despite draining the capacitor.

top_issues.issue: Firing the laser drains the capacitor bar but produces no visible laser beam or visual feedback, and no opponent Waymos are ever seen in the 3D world.
top_issues.evidence: From 00:07 to 00:16 (and Screenshots 3-5), the 'LASER CAPACITOR' drops from 100% down to 2% while Space is held, yet no beam is rendered from the roof dome and no other cars appear on the streets.
top_issues.fix_hint: Render a bright emissive cylinder/line or particle beam from the roof lidar dome toward the reticle when firing, and spawn opponent Waymos along the road ahead of the player.

top_issues.issue: The car drives into a narrow gap between two buildings and gets permanently wedged, dropping speed to 0-1 MPH despite forward throttle and boost inputs.
top_issues.evidence: At 00:07 (Screenshot 3) the car turns left into a building corner, and from 00:11 to 00:16 (Screenshots 4-5) it is stuck in the gap between the grey and red buildings at 0-1 MPH.
top_issues.fix_hint: Add smooth sliding wall collision response so the car deflects along building faces instead of snagging on corners or wedging between narrow building gaps.

top_issues.issue: The environment looks like flat-shaded procedural colored blocks in pitch-black night rather than realistic San Francisco streets.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 1-5 show plain red, blue, green, and grey box buildings with simple grid rectangles for windows, lacking Victorian bay windows, trees, overhead wires, sidewalks details, or daytime SF lighting seen in the reference photos.
top_issues.fix_hint: Switch to bright daytime/golden-hour lighting with a skybox, add SF architectural details (bay windows, cornices, horizontal siding, street trees, palm trees, overhead trolley wires, Bay Bridge vistas).

top_issues.issue: The player vehicle is just two stacked white boxes with a glowing blue puck on top, barely resembling a Jaguar I-PACE Waymo robotaxi.
top_issues.evidence: In Screenshots 1-5, the car has a boxy sedan/truck rear end with no sloped SUV roofline, no visible wheels from the rear angle, and lacks the front/corner/mirror sensor pods and Waymo branding.
top_issues.fix_hint: Shape the car body like a sleek white crossover SUV with a sloped rear window, visible wheels, distinct corner/fender lidar pods, side mirrors with sensors, and a proper spinning roof lidar turret.

top_issues.issue: Buildings float or intersect awkwardly with the sloped terrain, leaving dark voids and ledges where the car gets trapped.
top_issues.evidence: In Screenshots 4 and 5, the sidewalk/road edge forms a sharp ledge against the dark gap between the grey and red buildings where the car is wedged.
top_issues.fix_hint: Ensure building foundations extend well below the sloped terrain mesh and place continuous curbs/colliders along the sidewalk edge to keep vehicles on the street.

top_issues.issue: Firing the laser drains the 'LASER CAPACITOR' HUD bar from 100% down to 2%, yet no visible laser beams, projectiles, or muzzle flashes appear in the 3D viewport.
top_issues.evidence: From 00:07 to 00:16 (and Screenshots 3-5), the spacebar input drains the magenta capacitor bar, but nothing renders from the roof turret.
top_issues.fix_hint: Render bright emissive 3D cylinders/lines or particle beams from the roof lidar dome toward the reticle target when firing, with impact sparks on hit.

top_issues.issue: No opponent Waymo cars are visible anywhere in the streets during the entire test drive, leaving the world empty and devoid of laser tag combat.
top_issues.evidence: Across all 16 seconds of video and Screenshots 1-5, zero other vehicles appear on the road; only a single static red dot is seen on the edge of the radar.
top_issues.fix_hint: Spawn multiple AI-controlled Waymo robotaxis on nearby streets and intersections in front of the player that actively drive, chase, and fire lasers back.

top_issues.issue: The car drives into a narrow gap between two buildings and gets permanently stuck at 0-1 MPH, unable to slide along the wall or recover.
top_issues.evidence: At 00:07 the car hits a building wall (speed drops 45 to 4 MPH), and from 00:11 to 00:16 (Screenshots 4-5) it is wedged between two buildings at 0-1 MPH despite W+D and W+Shift inputs.
top_issues.fix_hint: Close narrow gaps between buildings into solid block colliders, and implement smooth sliding wall collision resolution so the car deflects along walls instead of snagging.
